d:
Sauvik Banerjjee, Group CTO - Rezolve Ai PLC and Chairman | Rezolve India, talks about leadership, decision-making, execution, and the future of business.
He explains:
• Why he believes intelligence matters more than hard work in certain high-stakes roles
• How to spot a bullshitter using the Say-Do Ratio before it costs you a promotion
• What elite spin bowlers teach us about the kind of intelligence that builds great leaders
• How to get promoted at work tips for cross functional ownership
• Why technically brilliant people consistently struggle to make the leap into leadership
